LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.title: Unique
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_UNIQUE.descriptio: Each player may keep only one copy of a card with this name in their permanent deck.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.title: Immortal Gu
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XIAN_GU.descripti: A Rank 6 or higher Gu. During this run, only one copy of the same Immortal Gu may exist across all players' permanent decks.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.title: Activation
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CUI_DONG.descript: A Gu card must be used with an Activation card in hand.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.title: Cooldown
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUI_FU.descriptio: After all activations are spent, the Gu enters the Gu Cooldown Pile and cannot be used. When the listed cooldown finishes, it returns to the Gu Storage Pile and then enters the Gu Hand in cooldown-completion order.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_KE_XUE.title: Bloodthirst
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_KE_XUE.descriptio: Spend the listed amount of Blood Essence to use or empower the corresponding effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZI_SHI.title: Self-Devour
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZI_SHI.descriptio: When paying Bloodthirst, lose 2 HP for each missing Blood Essence instead; this cannot reduce HP below 1.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI.title: Blood Qi
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI.descriptio: Adapts to the host: damage and Bleed, Block and Blood Essence, or direct Blood Essence. Higher ranks trigger multiple times.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI1.title: Blood Qi 1
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI1.descripti: The host triggers once, then hatches. Adapts to the host: attacks add damage and Bleed; skills gain Block and Blood Essence; powers gain Blood Essence.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI2.title: Blood Qi 2
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI2.descripti: The host triggers twice, then hatches. Adapts to the host: attacks add damage and Bleed; skills gain Block and Blood Essence; powers gain Blood Essence.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI3.title: Blood Qi 3
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_QI3.descripti: The host triggers three times, then hatches. Adapts to the host: attacks add damage and Bleed; skills gain Block and Blood Essence; powers gain Blood Essence.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUE_XIANG.title: Moon Phase
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YUE_XIANG.descrip: Blood Moon advances Crescent → Waxing → Full. Each complete host resolution advances one phase.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI.title: Blood Fetus
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XUE_TAI.descripti: A compound parasite. Each trigger adapts to the host and gains Fetal Movement; it hatches at 3.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TAI_DONG.title: Fetal Movement
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TAI_DONG.descript: Blood Fetus maturity. It hatches at 3; devouring another parasite can inherit 1–2 progress.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_TAI.title: Rupture
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_PO_TAI.descriptio: If an immature parasitized host enters Exhaust, remove the parasite and gain 1 Blood Essence without resolving remaining effects.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_FU_HUA.title: Hatch
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_FU_HUA.descriptio: The final resolution after a parasite completes its last trigger, after which it is removed.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TUN_JI.title: Devour Parasite
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_TUN_JI.descriptio: Blood Fetus replaces Blood Qi or a non-Full Moon parasite and inherits 1–2 Fetal Movement.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.title: Shared Pool
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZONG_E_DU.descrip: AoE damage, Bleed, or Blood Marks are shared totals divided among living enemies, not copied per enemy.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CAN_YUE.title: Crescent
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_CAN_YUE.descripti: Moon Phase stage 1. Resolve the lower shared damage and Bleed pool, then advance to Waxing.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YING_YUE.title: Waxing
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YING_YUE.descript: Moon Phase stage 2. Resolve the middle shared pool and possible Blood Marks, then advance to Full.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_MAN_YUE.title: Full Moon
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_MAN_YUE.descripti: Final Moon Phase. Resolve the largest shared pool and hatch; rank 6+ refunds Blood Essence and rank 9 also draws.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.title: Overflow
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YI_CHU.descriptio: When a resource gain exceeds its cap, the amount that could not be gained is converted into another benefit as stated by the card.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.title: Pursuit
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_ZHUI_JI.descripti: If the target dies, unresolved remaining hits move to another living enemy.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA1.title: Illumination 1
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA1.descript: When you have at least 1 Radiance, automatically spend 1 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA2.title: Illumination 2
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA2.descript: When you have at least 2 Radiance, automatically spend 2 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA3.title: Illumination 3
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA3.descript: When you have at least 3 Radiance, automatically spend 3 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA4.title: Illumination 4
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA4.descript: When you have at least 4 Radiance, automatically spend 4 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA5.title: Illumination 5
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA5.descript: When you have at least 5 Radiance, automatically spend 5 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA6.title: Illumination 6
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA6.descript: When you have at least 6 Radiance, automatically spend 6 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA7.title: Illumination 7
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA7.descript: When you have at least 7 Radiance, automatically spend 7 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA8.title: Illumination 8
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA8.descript: When you have at least 8 Radiance, automatically spend 8 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA9.title: Illumination 9
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_YAO_HUA9.descript: When you have at least 9 Radiance, automatically spend 9 Radiance and trigger this card’s Illumination effect.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI1.title: Devour Remains 1
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI1.descript: Choose up to 1 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI2.title: Devour Remains 2
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI2.descript: Choose up to 2 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI3.title: Devour Remains 3
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SHI_HAI3.descript: Choose up to 3 Remains in your hand to consume or absorb; see this card's description for the effect. Remains are gained when a Blood Path Gu card kills an enemy, or when Bleed kills it; unused Remains are kept in your permanent deck after combat.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.title: Phantom
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XU_YING.descripti: Remains in hand and cannot be played manually. After a non-Phantom Attack, the Strength controller checks manifestations in stable order. Phantoms do not trigger other Phantoms.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_LIAN_LI.title: Strength Training
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_LIAN_LI.descripti: Strength Gu begin each combat sealed. The first resolution of their matching permanent companion card adds training; temporary copies and replays do not count. Full progress unseals the Gu.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_NING_YING.title: Condense Phantom
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_NING_YING.descrip: Activating a Strength Gu whose Phantom is already present raises that Phantom's base manifestation chance instead of creating another: +10% at ranks 1–5, +15% at 6–8, and +20% at 9, capped at 80%.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_NIAN_HUA.title: Years
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_NIAN_HUA.descript: Time Path resource, max 6. Reaching 6 immediately triggers Year Complete.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SUI_MAN.title: Year Complete
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_SUI_MAN.descripti: At 6 Years, choose a recovering Gu to reduce its remaining recovery by 1 turn, and extend all duration-based enemy debuffs by 1 turn.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUAN_BU.title: Slow Steps
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_HUAN_BU.descripti: An enemy attack shares one fixed damage-reduction budget across all hits. It ticks down by turns and can be extended by Year Complete.
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XI_YING.title: Past Echo
LU_GU_ZHEN_REN_KEYWORD_XI_YING.descripti: A temporary copy created by Backtrack Gu. It Exhausts, cannot be Backtracked again, and grants Years when played.
